meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

attemptsLog.error: DataForSEO gemini task error 40102: No Search Results.

response.text:
For acne-prone skin, serums containing **Salicylic Acid (BHA)**, **Niacinamide**, or **Azelaic Acid** work best because they clear pores, control excess oil, and reduce active breakouts.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=*%20Garnier%20Vitamin%20C%20%2B%20Face%20Serum,ml%2030%20ml.%20*%20The%20Derma%20Co.)

Here are top-rated face serum options available in India under ₹700:

The HYPHEN Anti Acne Daily Serum combines **2% Salicylic Acid** and **10% Azelaic Acid** to target active acne, reduce post-blemish marks, and regulate oil.

The Pilgrim Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Oil Control Serum uses a blend of **2% BHA** and **3% Niacinamide** to gently exfoliate pores, smooth skin texture, and prevent future breakouts.

The Avimee Herbal Salicylic Acid Face Serum features **2% Salicylic Acid**, **Tea Tree Oil**, and **Hyaluronic Acid** to clear out sebum and unclog pores while keeping skin hydrated.

The Dermistry Salicylic Acid Zinc Face Serum pairs **Salicylic Acid** with **Zinc** to reduce active acne, calm redness and inflammation, and minimize the appearance of scars.

The Fixderma Anti Acne Serum contains **2% Salicylic Acid** along with **Azelaic Acid** and **Mandelic Acid** to target stubborn breakouts, dark spots, and excess sebum.

### Summary Recommendation

* Choose **HYPHEN** or **Fixderma** if you want a multi-acid approach targeting both active breakouts and leftover marks.
* Choose **Pilgrim** for an everyday lightweight option that balances oil production with niacinamide.
